do.text: Use a combobox for a long list people find by typing: countries, people, repositories.

dont.text: Don't make people search three sizes they can read at a glance: use a select or a toggle group.

do.text: Say what to try next when the search finds nothing.

dont.text: Don't answer a search with "Error.": nothing went wrong, and it says nothing useful.

do.text: Show several picks as chips people can see and remove one by one.

dont.text: Don't squeeze many picks into one truncated line that hides most of them.
